# Microsoft Codicons

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons

Version: `@vscode/codicons` 0.0.36, tag commit
`f82216e8ddcdf0c31eb1e5074a87bb88b3cf7517`.
The unmodified `dist/codicon.ttf` comes from the matching official npm package.
Icons are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (`LICENSE`); code is MIT (`LICENSE-CODE`).

Used for Shinkou editor toolbar, hierarchy and inspector glyphs. Font sizes
follow the editor DPI atlas rebuild. Each icon button retains a text tooltip;
text buttons are used if the font is unavailable. No online asset loads occur.
